idea-plugin.name: Flutter Developer Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Complete Flutter & Dart Development Enhancement Suite

Supercharge your Flutter and Dart development with intelligent pubspec.yaml management, enhanced code documentation, advanced navigation tools, and powerful visualization features—all seamlessly integrated into your IDE.

Key Features

🔍 Smart Package Management

  • Auto-complete pub.dev packages with real-time search and Flutter Favorites (⭐) badge
  • Inline update notifications with safe upgrade options (skip major versions)
  • One-click upgrades with optional automatic flutter pub get execution
  • Health indicators for discontinued and Dart 3 incompatible packages

📚 Rich Documentation Access

  • Pubspec.yaml: Hover over packages for README or versions for CHANGELOG
  • Dart Code: Enhanced documentation with syntax-highlighted code examples matching your IDE theme
  • Supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Codeberg, and SourceHut repositories
  • Intelligent monorepo package handling

🧭 Enhanced Navigation

  • Quick Links: CMD/CTRL+click package names to open pub.dev pages
  • Breadcrumbs: Rich navigation bar with customizable icons and widgets showing classes, methods, functions, constructors, mixins, enums, and extensions
  • Code Lens: Usage and implementation counts for code elements

💡 Intelligent Code Hints

  • Parameter name hints for non-named method arguments
  • Type hints for inferred variable types (var, final, const)
  • Configurable display options (before/after identifier)

📊 Visualization Tools

  • Widget Usage Heatmap: Visual analysis of widget usage across your project with color-coded intensity indicators
  • Support filtering, CSV/PNG export, and auto-refresh

⚡ Quick Actions

  • Run 'Flutter gen-l10n' directly from .arb files

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1+ with Flutter and Dart plugins installed.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.0

Pubspec.yaml Intelligence

  • Smart Auto-completion: Pub.dev package suggestions with popularity indicators
  • Package Documentation: Hover for README and CHANGELOG with repository links
  • Update Management: Inline hints with safe/full upgrade quick fixes
  • Health Warnings: Visual badges for discontinued and incompatible packages
  • Quick Navigation: Click-through to pub.dev package and version pages

Dart Code Enhancement

  • Syntax-Highlighted Documentation: Code examples in hover docs respect your IDE color scheme
  • Enhanced Breadcrumbs: Configurable navigation bar with custom icons and widgets for classes, methods, constructors, mixins, enums, extensions, getters, and setters
  • Parameter Hints: Show parameter names for non-named arguments
  • Type Hints: Display inferred types for variables and parameters
  • Code Lens: Usage counts and implementation counts for code elements

Visualization Tools

  • Widget Usage Heatmap Tool Window: Analyze widget usage patterns across your Flutter project
    • Visual heatmap with color-coded intensity (green to red)
    • Sortable table showing usage count, file count, and inheritance info
    • Filter by custom widgets or high-usage widgets (>10 references)
    • Export to CSV for further analysis
    • Double-click navigation to widget definitions
    • Manual refresh with last updated timestamp
    • Helps identify refactoring candidates and reusable components

Quick Actions

  • Run 'Flutter gen-l10n' directly from .arb files

Additional Features

  • Multi-repository support (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Codeberg, SourceHut)
  • Monorepo-aware package documentation fetching
  • Configurable hint display options
  • Cache management for optimal performance
  • Full light and dark theme support for all visualization tools
